name: curran-design-system
description: Single source of truth for tokens, fonts, and conventions. Edit this file, then run `npm run tokens` to regenerate app/tokens.css. Portable: drop this file + scripts/build-tokens.mjs into any sibling project (e.g. enai-website) for identical semantics.

color._comment: semantic tokens are what components reference (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, ...). `ref` points at a scale step and resolves per-mode automatically via the Radix light/dark CSS. `value` is a literal defined per mode (used for the brand accent, which isn't in the Radix sand scale).

serif.note: Full family is 12 faces; only Light/Regular (+italics) are loaded here. Do NOT use the watermarked `Test*`/trial copies that exist elsewhere on disk.

conventions.darkMode: next-themes, attribute=class, toggles `.dark` on <html> (matches Radix sand-dark selector)
conventions.components: default-export PascalCase; interactive ones start with 'use client'

registry._comment: portability contract per shareable component — what's safe to lift into another project and what it drags in.
